episodes.title: Chapter 01: A Whole New Whirled
episodes.summary: After making a miraculous recovery, Peacemaker returns home -- only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

episodes.title: Chapter 02: Best Friends for Never
episodes.summary: After Peacemaker's hazardous escape from a disastrous metahuman hookup, tension and mistrust build within the team.

episodes.title: Chapter 03: Better Goff Dead
episodes.summary: On their first official mission to assassinate suspected "butterflies," Economos and Murn bond, and Peacemaker and Harcourt reach an understanding.

episodes.title: Chapter 04: The Choad Less Traveled
episodes.summary: After learning that the team helped land his father in prison, Peacemaker confronts his complicated past.

episodes.title: Chapter 05: Monkey Dory
episodes.summary: The team scouts the apparent hub for the aliens' food supply, only to come face-to-face with a full-fledged invasion.

episodes.title: Chapter 06: Murn After Reading
episodes.summary: Murn reveals his deepest secret. Auggie is set free. The botched arrest of Peacemaker sends alien Goff into an unexpected new host.

episodes.title: Chapter 07: Stop Dragon My Heart Around
episodes.summary: Harcourt, Murn and Adebayo find themselves surrounded by an alien force, while Peacemaker squares off against his father.

episodes.title: Chapter 08: It's Cow or Never
episodes.summary: With Peacemaker and Adebayo at odds, can the team kill the cow once and for all?

episodes.title: Chapter 01: The Ties That Grind
episodes.summary: While Peacemaker attempts to join the Justice Gang, Harcourt struggles to find work, and Economos takes on a challenging new assignment.

episodes.title: Chapter 02: A Man Is Only as Good as His Bird
episodes.summary: As Economos clashes with his new handler, Peacemaker must deal with the consequences of his actions in the alternate dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter 03: Another Rick Up My Sleeve
episodes.summary: Economos pays for the team's bungled mission, while Peacemaker explores the depths of his relationship with Harcourt in the other dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter 04: Need I Say Door
episodes.summary: As A.R.G.U.S. ramps up efforts to find the QUC, Harcourt receives a tempting offer from Flag – which comes at a steep cost to Peacemaker.

episodes.title: Chapter 05: Back to the Suture
episodes.summary: After a catastrophic showdown with Flag, Peacemaker makes a shocking decision, while his friends scramble to keep the 11th Street Kids together.

episodes.title: Chapter 06: Ignorance Is Chris
episodes.summary: As the 11th Street Kids fight to bring their missing member home, Flag doubles down on his efforts to hold Peacemaker accountable.

episodes.title: Chapter 07: Like a Keith in the Night
episodes.summary: As Flag and A.R.G.U.S. close in, the 11th Street Kids attempt to keep the ever-increasing dangers of the alternate world around them at bay.

episodes.title: Chapter 08: Full Nelson
episodes.summary: As Flag puts everyone around him in increasing danger, the 11th Street Kids must convince Peacemaker that he's one of them.
